description: An agent builds a task, and a check proves it after each try. Sonnet tries up to 3 times, each try with the last failure. Then Opus tries.

inputs.name: task
inputs.label: Task
inputs.description: What to build or fix, in plain words.

inputs.name: check
inputs.label: Check
inputs.description: The shell command that proves the work, for example the tests.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: What the agent reports it did.

outputs.name: tier
outputs.description: The tier that finished the task: sonnet or opus.

nodes.label: Implement
nodes.check:
sh -c "{{check}}" || exit 1
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
	echo 'Commit your changes. Not committed:'
	git status --short
	exit 1
fi
